display_name: Local Ollama vision model (qwen2.5-vl 7b, higher accuracy, OOM-risky under fullscreen game)

metadata.oom_note: 2026-08-27: 7b (~5.6 GiB + vision projector) did NOT fit alongside the fullscreen UNO game on the RTX 5060 Ti 16 GiB — cudaMalloc OOM, llama-server crashes, Ollama evict/reload loops, the Electron game window losing its GPU surface. Operator chose 'no restriction' for the model picker (2026-08-28): the profile is selectable, but if VRAM pressure appears (monitor flicker, game window glitching, evict/reload logs in Ollama) fall back to local/ollama-vlm (3b). Warm-up loads the model on session start via /model before the first tick.
metadata.perf: 7b warm ~6-15s/call on this GPU when it fits (vs 3b ~1.2-4s).
